officialTitle: Palbociclib in Hormone-Receptor-Positive Advanced Breast Cancer
setting: Advanced disease that relapsed or progressed during prior endocrine therapy

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: This phase 3 study involved 521 patients with advanced hormone-receptor-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative breast cancer that had relapsed or progressed during prior endocrine therapy.
design.notes: 2:1 randomisation. Premenopausal or perimenopausal women also received goserelin.

clinicalQuestion: Does adding palbociclib to fulvestrant improve outcomes in HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer that progressed on prior endocrine therapy?

pico.population: HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer relapsed or progressed during prior endocrine therapy (any menopausal status)
pico.intervention: Palbociclib plus fulvestrant (plus goserelin if pre/perimenopausal)
pico.outcomes: Primary: investigator-assessed PFS. Secondary: OS, objective response, clinical benefit, PROs, safety

arms.label: Palbociclib + fulvestrant
arms.regimen: Palbociclib plus fulvestrant (goserelin for pre/perimenopausal women)

arms.label: Placebo + fulvestrant
arms.regimen: Placebo plus fulvestrant (goserelin for pre/perimenopausal women)

publications.title: Palbociclib in Hormone-Receptor-Positive Advanced Breast Cancer.
publications.label: Preplanned interim PFS analysis

publications.title: Overall Survival with Palbociclib and Fulvestrant in Advanced Breast Cancer.
publications.label: Prespecified OS analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: The median progression-free survival was 9.2 months (95% confidence interval [CI], 7.5 to not estimable) with palbociclib-fulvestrant and 3.8 months (95% CI, 3.5 to 5.5) with placebo-fulvestrant (hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.42; 95% CI, 0.32 to 0.56; P<0.001).

Among 521 patients who underwent randomization, the median overall survival was 34.9 months (95% confidence interval [CI], 28.8 to 40.0) in the palbociclib-fulvestrant group and 28.0 months (95% CI, 23.6 to 34.6) in the placebo-fulvestrant group (hazard ratio for death, 0.81; 95% CI, 0.64 to 1.03; P=0.09; absolute difference, 6.9 months).

outcomes.population: Sensitivity to previous endocrine therapy (prespecified stratification subgroup)
outcomes.sourceQuote: Among 410 patients with sensitivity to previous endocrine therapy, the median overall survival was 39.7 months (95% CI, 34.8 to 45.7) in the palbociclib-fulvestrant group and 29.7 months (95% CI, 23.8 to 37.9) in the placebo-fulvestrant group (hazard ratio, 0.72; 95% CI, 0.55 to 0.94; absolute difference, 10.0 months).

the median time to the receipt of chemotherapy was 17.6 months in the palbociclib-fulvestrant group, as compared with 8.8 months in the placebo-fulvestrant group (hazard ratio, 0.58; 95% CI, 0.47 to 0.73; P<0.001)

safety.sourceQuote: The most common grade 3 or 4 adverse events in the palbociclib-fulvestrant group were neutropenia (62.0%, vs. 0.6% in the placebo-fulvestrant group)
The rate of discontinuation due to adverse events was 2.6% with palbociclib and 1.7% with placebo.

strengths: Placebo-controlled randomised phase III trial in endocrine-pretreated disease
Included pre/perimenopausal women with ovarian suppression
limitations: OS improvement in the overall population did not reach statistical significance
Primary PFS reported at an interim analysis; investigator-assessed

clinicalImplications.text: Supports palbociclib plus fulvestrant after progression on endocrine therapy in HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer; the OS difference was not statistically significant overall, with a larger effect in endocrine-sensitive patients.

tumourBoardPearl.text: PALOMA-3 delayed chemotherapy substantially, but its overall OS difference was not significant — do not quote it as an OS-positive trial.

curation.notes: Numbers transcribed from PubMed abstracts of PMID 26030518 (primary PFS) and PMID 30345905 (OS). Result classified POSITIVE on the primary PFS endpoint.
